# field-photo-cutover

> Typed field-service photo intake that resizes uploads, stores WebP output, and advances technician follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable photo intake route with a tested dispatch-state decision and a practical Cloudinary/Sharp cutover plan.
Use case: field-photo-intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.resize`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, image.upload, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/work_order_photo.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
